summary: The Backrooms is a survival RPG built around authored maze levels, player-specific Backrooms rooms, and a shared Bonus Room mall. The player template composes combat, interaction, appearance, UI and routing behaviors; place scenes and simulations supply level layouts, NPCs and local systems.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall: diner, clothing/furniture counters, arcade, gallery, fountain and teleport station; sim adds staff, shoppers and balcony loungers.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0 / Lobby maze and hub; sim generates office furniture and sunken props, stairs, shifting walls, moments, loot and smilers/lurkers.
places/intake (3D) - bedroom character-creation space; scripts/intake-geo.js and intro cutscene support its authored room.
places/tutorial0 (3D, solo ephemeral) - authored Level 0 tutorial route, staged encounter, HALOGEN and local props/lights; tut0 coordinate/data libraries drive generated detail.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams and Locked; authored levels plus simulated 2.1 rooms, zones and agents.
places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems and Boiler Room Death Rats.
places/level6, places/level7, places/level10, places/level11 (3D) - later authored or generated levels, including city/farm/venues and their local simulations.
places/debug, places/spamton (3D) - modeling/test scene and separate Spamton basement/boss space.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry, configured player actions/HUD, routing, player cap and menu action.
templates/player.js + templates/camera.js; scripts/camera.js - ordered player behavior/camera entries; view3 enables third-person mode.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place configuration and authored placements, with sim scripts adding local generated/ticked behavior.
sim.js - world cadence and out-of-bounds recovery/destruction; places/main/sim.js - Level 0 generation, loot/ecology and place-state timers.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - local title/pause, character creation, arrival and tutorial routing.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js + scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom shell and waking sequence.
places/tutorial0/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/tut0-geo.js + scripts/tut0-panels-geo.js + places/tutorial0/sim.js - tutorial layout and props from scripts/lib/tut0.js.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/hub-ui.js + scripts/build-ui.js + scripts/cutscene-ui.js + scripts/wardrobe-ui.js - HUD, mall/build/cutscene presentation and critter appearance creator.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations, crossings; used by scripts/routing.js and scripts/hub.js.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build specs/models shared by B-mode and home reconstruction.
scripts/lib/screen.js - read-only screen classifier and wrist-panel gates shared by player, stats, craft, rest and menu inputs.
scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/level*.js + level data - grids, zones, layouts and paths reused by place sims, geometry and navigation.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - place-sim NPC management, throttling and return timing.
scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml + critter.yml + hair.yml + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - garment/look rules, NPC look rolls and critter models shared by creator and NPC spawns.
scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + level data; combat.js + combat.yml + ballistics.js - common item/container and player/NPC damage/weapon rules.
scripts/lib/nav.js + builtin/nav; footsteps.js + footsteps.yml; level quest libraries - reusable navigation, surface sounds and quest definitions for NPC/talk/place systems.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/bonus/sim.js - cadence, tick; level11/21/61 sims supply their respective generators/ticks.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js - MESH, critterSpec, bodyModel, headModel, hairOf, hairChild, seatHair, seatHead, rewear and appearance helpers.
scripts/lib/clothes.js - SLOTS, fullLook, wear/takeOff/stripTo, rollCloth, npcLook, plainLook and armor/clothing helpers.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update; scripts/build.js - onInput, update; scripts/hub.js - clothName, update, onInput.
scripts/lib/hub.js - HUB_ROOM, HUB_PLACE, isHubRoom, soloRoom, HOMES, toHub, toSolo; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.
scripts/bonus-counter.js - ears.press; scripts/hub-ui.js - hubUi; scripts/cutscene-ui.js - cutUi, t0Fade; scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js - t0Tick; scripts/player.js owns progression/combat/input handlers.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs, money, visits, combat/rewards, appearance, karma/rep and level access.
scripts/build.js - active B-mode selection/ghost/session and placed build pieces; player.state.homeKeep.built persists owner-home builds, reconstructed by home sim via build-piece.js.
scripts/hub.js - local mall offer/shop/food and room-hop flags; mall purchases update cents/furn/cloth/hubFood and session-held food model.
scripts/grab.js - carried object and carry/session fields; strength, load, health and stamina limit lifting.
scripts/lib/fishing.js + scripts/bobber.js - fishing session/outcome and spawned float state.
scripts/stats.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags and sheet state; interact.js + lib/seat.js own focus, loot, sit and configured storage saves.
scripts/talk.js and quest libraries - dialogue/shop UI, rapport/trade/rep, authored effects, quest keys/HUD/payout; scripts/l8-use.js owns Level 8 interaction flags.
places/main/sim.js - places/main place.state generation/version flags and respawn timers for Level 0 furniture, stairs, moments, breaks and creatures.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde/critter/main-menu/hub/view3; routing is configured there.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
scripts/routing.js pickRoom accepts permitted requested room; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects a player's solo Backrooms room, with bonus overflow IDs for mall capacity.
Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js title menu; START enters intake for character creation or completed character goes to bonus; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done.
scripts/lib/hub.js toHub/toSolo → room/place crossings; roomHop distinguishes intentional crossings from launch/resume; mall return targets solo Level 0 or eligible home.
Death recovery outside bonus → scripts/hub.js sets hubOffer → hub-ui.js renders it; hub handler returns via toHub and handles local mall counters, purchases and teleport choices.

Placed bonus-counter.js ears.press writes the player's hubShop by counter kind → scripts/hub.js handles input → scripts/hub-ui.js renders diner/clothes/furniture/station menu; purchases debit cents and grant configured stock.
Diner purchase → scripts/hub.js writes hubFood, spawns short-lived food model attached to RightHand and emits sound; UI/diner models read hubFood; the held object is session-scoped and mall-local.
Mall scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml → places/bonus/sim.js spawns staff and NPCs; five shoppers use scripts/mall-shopper.js waypoint paths/idle pauses; npcLook/critterSpec supply their appearance.
Mall furniture unlock in player.state.furn → build-piece.js furn_ rows/tabs → scripts/build.js B-mode places models; homeKeep.built is rebuilt by home11 sim using the same specs.

Level 0 places/main/sim.js initializes generated desk drawers as containers with weighted contents, clears legacy loose ammo and no longer seeds floor ammo; container/body loot remains the ammo source.

Main-menu arrivalPending in main/tutorial0 → scripts/lib/arrive-cut.js stages landing → scripts/lib/tutorial.js starts route; tutorial main-menu behavior polls tut0-cut.js → cutscene-ui.js captions/fade and ui.js presents t0Fade; level-door transfers use clipKind/xfer.kind.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js - one authored mall with counters/landmarks and data-driven shop content; sim spawns four fixed staff, five waypoint shoppers and two static balcony friends.
scripts/mall-shopper.js + places/bonus/sim.js - same kinematic stroll/stop/animation behavior across five shopper critters; individualized route state selects connected walkway waypoints and pauses.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - models/dimensions vary by catalog piece while common spec/save/rebuild path handles placement.
places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light and red-zone variants; Level 5 includes portal/quest props and Boiler Room Death Rat packs.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office layout/fixtures, resident schedules and home claims.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC role/dialogue/look/routine varies by person; meg-agent.js provides shared combat/social behavior.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter.yml/hair.yml - player and NPC critters share body/head/face/hair rendering; wardrobe choices and deterministic ID-based NPC rolls vary by sex, style, colour and look.

scripts/lib/level11-city.js + level11-models.yml + art/level11 kits - generated building/prop variation by seeded district/model/placement; sim adds city life, traffic, tram, adverts and canal crossings.
migrationNotes: Bonus Room uses shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room, and overflow mall rooms use bonus-N IDs. Keep routing and hub identity aligned.
Furniture bought in mall unlocks player.state.furn; B-mode uses furn_<key>; home builds persist in homeKeep.built and home sim reconstructs shared build-piece specs. Keep stored rows compatible.

Level 0's places/main/sim.js deskV conversion makes ordinary desks loot containers and clears old floor ammo once; desks have weighted contents without ammo, so retain container/body ammo sourcing and the room-state migration guard.

scripts/lib/tut0.js is shared route-coordinate source for geometry, scene placements, simulation props and beat positions; tutorial cutscene runs in the player's main-menu behavior, not place referee.

Critter hair styles are sex-prefixed keys from critter.yml and models in hair.yml, skinned to Head as child id critter-hair; masks suppress hair. npcLook hashes ID for stable hair/style colour, so keep key naming/data consistent.
scripts/lib/screen.js remains derived/read-only: priority cutscene > menu > wardrobe > mahjong > talk > loot > wrist sheet/inventory/craft/rest > play; only wrist panels replace another wrist panel.
